About TAPL

Built to turn potential into performance.

You're capable. You know you're capable. Everyone around you knows you're capable. So why does the gap between what you could be doing and what you're actually getting done feel impossible to close?

You've read the books. You've tried the systems. You've started Monday again forty times. The problem isn't motivation, isn't discipline, isn't intelligence. The problem is that everything you've been given was designed for a brain that isn't yours.

Dan Williams · Founder
Meet your coach

The person behind the method.

Hi, I'm Dan. I coach business professionals, founders and entrepreneurs who have ADHD and are quietly running at a fraction of what they're capable of.

I know the feeling. I spent most of my life doing it.

Diagnosed in my late twenties, after years of focus problems, disorganisation, and being told I had 'so much potential, if only I'd apply myself'. A narrative far too many of us know.

I've spent almost a decade in corporate positions. Most recently, alongside my role as Mid-Market Account Executive at a leading Fortune 500 tech company, I led the Neurodiversity Team for EMEA and APAC.

That role taught me something the wellness content tends to skip. The corporate world was not designed with ADHD in mind, and it was not built to support it.

The awareness is growing. The infrastructure is playing catch-up.

So talented people burn out. They churn through jobs, second-guess their ability, and carry a quiet, permanent sense of being 'not good enough'. Not for lack of talent. Because the environment is often incompatible with brains that are 'wired differently'.

TAPL is the coaching practice I wish I'd had when I was diagnosed and couldn't find the right kind of help.

The work is practical, and deeply reflective. We go deep, stripping back the layers to uncover the root cause of the challenge.

Then we help you build the systems, strategies and frameworks to manage your ADHD in high-pressure environments.

And the harder, more valuable part: facilitating the rewiring of years of negative conditioning, and giving you the catalyst to reframe your ADHD. From a 'fault to hide' or 'problem to solve', to a way of thinking, and a strength to be leveraged with the right infrastructure in place.

Our goal is to help you discover and harness your 'why', unlock your performance and fulfilment, and create balance on your own terms.

What we believe

The performance gap is a wiring difference, not an effort problem.

What we believe

The performance gap for most ADHD professionals isn't about effort or intelligence. It's a wiring difference: a mismatch between how your brain processes information and the environments and systems most workplaces are built on.

TAPL exists to close that distance. Not with productivity hacks or willpower frameworks, but with deeply personalised systems designed for how you think, work, and perform.

Our approach

Everything at TAPL is grounded in executive function research and ADHD neuroscience, and delivered through ICF-aligned coaching methodology.

From there, the work follows a clear sequence: identifying your specific friction points, designing external systems to address them, and embedding those systems into daily practice.

Explore the approach →

Outside the work

Beyond the practice.

I live in Brighton, on the south coast. It's creative, vibrant and forward-thinking, which is a reflection of how I try to approach business, neurodiversity and life balance. A good place to think differently, turn ideas into something real, and switch off with a walk on the beach after a heavy week.

I'm a musician and producer. Drums since I was five, then a degree in music production. My taste runs to the louder end, pop-punk and metal mostly, and there isn't much I enjoy more than a sweaty rock gig. I'm also a recent and fully converted fantasy reader (my girlfriend's doing). A good book, a cold cider and a sunny beer garden is about as close to perfect as I get.

Finding the balance between work and play is a permanent work in progress. ADHD tends to come with big ambition and a habit of hyperfocusing on one at the total expense of the other. So I make switching off the priority, not the afterthought. Whether that's a gig, a book, exercise, or just sitting and thinking.

Because you can't be fully 'on' without knowing how to be properly 'off'.

The discovery call is a conversation.

Why coaching works

This isn't about fixing you.
It's about designing systems that work for you.

ADHD isn't a deficit of intelligence or will. It's a difference in how the brain activates. Coaching builds the external systems that close that distance.

Unlike courses or content, coaching adapts entirely to you: your role, your working style, your exact friction patterns. Nothing generic enters the room.

For many people with ADHD, external accountability isn't a crutch. It's neurologically necessary. Coaching provides a consistent, structured source of that activation.

Professionals, business owners, founders and entrepreneurs navigating real complexity. This is a specific performance context. TAPL works exclusively in that space. Not students, not general wellbeing. Performance.

The approach

How we typically begin.

This isn't about fixing what's broken. It's about uncovering how you actually work, and building from there. Here's the shape it usually takes, though no two journeys run the same.

Surface
Sessions
1–3

We surface the core challenges together, using workflows like friction mapping alongside groundwork on your values and executive function strengths. From the first session, we start working on what matters most.

Exploration
Sessions
4–6

We dig deeper into the challenges and the factors underneath them: the schemas and conditioning that quietly shape how you see your work, and yourself. The fuller picture comes into view.

Iteration
Sessions
7–9

We refine, iterate and optimise strategies based on how they are translating in your world, keeping what lands and reworking what doesn't. Theory becomes habit through repetition and adjustment.

Execution
Sessions
10–12

We lock in what's working, let go of what isn't, and define your path forward. You leave with a clear read on your patterns and a roadmap to carry it on.

Underpinning every phase are weekly actions, working through your friction points from the most impactful down. Beyond these twelve sessions the work becomes cyclical, and it deepens rather than ends.

How coaching programmes work+

All coaching runs as a 12-week programme. Foundation is 6 sessions, Pro and Business are 12. The programme has a defined start and end.

The 12 weeks exist for a delivery reason. Meaningful change in executive function is not typically visible in four sessions, and the early phase of coaching surfaces patterns rather than resolving them. Twelve weeks gives the work enough runway to be judged fairly.

Ending a programme early is possible on 7 days notice, with an early exit fee. Full terms are set out in the Coaching Services Agreement, which we send before you commit to anything.

Payment is by direct debit, either in three monthly instalments or in full at the start if you take the discounted option.

Executive function
You don't need a diagnosis to experience this

Executive function challenges are far more common than ADHD diagnoses, and they show up in highly intelligent, deeply capable professionals every day. If you recognise yourself in this page, TAPL was built for you.

What is executive function?

Executive function is the set of cognitive processes that allow us to plan, prioritise, initiate, and follow through on tasks: to manage our time, regulate our emotions under pressure, and hold multiple things in mind while doing complex work.

These processes live primarily in the prefrontal cortex and are central to almost everything a professional does. When they work well, they're invisible. When they're challenged by ADHD, stress, burnout, or neurological variation, the distance between your capability and your output can feel enormous and inexplicable.

Crucially: executive function challenges exist on a spectrum. You don't need an ADHD diagnosis to experience meaningful friction in these areas, and you don't need to identify as neurodivergent for TAPL's approach to be exactly right for you.

Common executive function challenges
⚡
Initiation & getting started

Difficulty beginning tasks, even ones you want to do and know are important. Often misread as procrastination or laziness, when it's actually a neurological activation challenge.

🎯
Focus & sustained attention

Struggling to maintain concentration on demanding cognitive work, particularly in environments with competing stimuli or low intrinsic interest.

🔄
Prioritisation & planning

Difficulty identifying and consistently acting on what's most important, not for lack of intelligence, but because the salience signals that make priorities feel urgent are unreliable.

🧠
Working memory

Challenges holding multiple threads in mind simultaneously while doing complex work, leading to dropped balls, missed context, and feeling overwhelmed even when the actual workload isn't extreme.

⏰
Time perception & management

A fundamentally different relationship with time, where future deadlines don't create present urgency, and hours can disappear without registering until it's too late.

🌊
Emotional regulation under pressure

Heightened reactivity to frustration, rejection, or overwhelm, and difficulty returning quickly to a regulated, productive state once triggered.

Do I need a diagnosis to work with TAPL?

No. TAPL works with professionals who experience executive function challenges, with or without a formal ADHD diagnosis, and with or without a neurodivergent identity.

What matters is whether you recognise these patterns in yourself, and whether you're ready to build systems that actually work for your brain. The diagnostic question is for clinicians. The performance question is what we work on.

1. Confidentiality

1.1 Coach’s Obligations

The Coach will not disclose the Client’s personal information, session content, or any other identifying information to any third party without the Client’s prior written consent, except in the following circumstances:

  • Where the Coach is required to do so by law or by a court order
  • Where disclosure is necessary to prevent serious harm to the Client or to another person
  • Where information is shared in the context of professional supervision, in which case the Coach will ensure the supervisor is bound by equivalent confidentiality obligations and that no identifying information is shared unless strictly necessary

The Coach will document only factual information relating to the coaching engagement. No opinions, interpretations, or subjective assessments beyond what is necessary for professional record-keeping will be recorded.

1.2 Client’s Obligations

The Client agrees to treat as confidential any information, materials, tools, methods, or processes shared by the Coach as part of the coaching engagement. This obligation applies both during and after the term of the Agreement.

1.3 Session Recordings

The Coach records coaching sessions for internal quality and professional development purposes. Recording is not a condition of the coaching engagement.

The Client may consent to or decline recording by indicating their preference at onboarding, and may change that preference at any time by written notice. Declining will have no bearing on the coaching relationship or on the services provided.

All recordings are held securely and treated as confidential in the same way as all other session content. Recordings will not be shared with any third party without the Client’s prior written consent.

4. Limitation of Liability

Coaching is not a substitute for professional medical, psychological, legal, or financial advice. The Client takes full responsibility for all decisions made and actions taken as a result of or in connection with the coaching engagement.

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, the total liability of TAPL and The ADHD Performance Lab Ltd to the Client in respect of any claims arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Client under this Agreement.

TAPL and The ADHD Performance Lab Ltd shall not be liable for any indirect, consequential, or special loss, including but not limited to loss of revenue, loss of business, or reputational damage, howsoever arising.

Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or any other liability that cannot lawfully be limited or excluded.

5. Complaints

If the Client is dissatisfied with any aspect of the coaching relationship, they are encouraged to raise the matter with the Coach in the first instance, by email to hello@tapl.coach. The Coach will acknowledge any complaint within 5 working days and will respond substantively within 20 working days.

Where a complaint cannot be resolved directly, nothing in this Agreement affects the Client’s statutory rights or their ability to pursue the matter through any other route available to them.

Where the matter concerns the handling of personal data, the Client may complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk.

6. Governing Law and Jurisdiction

This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. Both Parties agree that the courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.

Where the Client is based outside England and Wales, both Parties acknowledge that the Coach operates under English law and that this Agreement will be interpreted and enforced accordingly. Nothing in this Agreement is intended to waive any consumer rights the Client may have under the laws of their own jurisdiction where those rights cannot be contractually excluded.

7. Entire Agreement and Amendments

This document, together with the Coaching Services Agreement and the Pricing and Programme Details page, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties in respect of the coaching services. It supersedes all prior discussions, representations, and agreements.

Any amendment to this Agreement must be agreed in writing and signed by both Parties. If any provision of this Agreement is found to be unenforceable, the remaining provisions will continue in full force and effect.

These Terms and Conditions are incorporated into and form part of the Coaching Services Agreement signed by the Client and the Coach.

Refund & Dispute Policy

This policy sets out when refunds are and are not available across everything TAPL sells. It applies alongside the Terms and Conditions and the Coaching Services Agreement.

Your statutory right to cancel

If you are a consumer, meaning an individual acting wholly or mainly outside your trade, business, craft or profession, and you buy from us at a distance, you have 14 days from entering into the contract to cancel for any reason.

If you ask us to begin before those 14 days are up and then cancel, you pay only for what has actually been delivered, calculated in proportion to the total fee. No early exit fee applies.

You lose the right to cancel once the service has been fully performed, where performance began at your express request and with your acknowledgement that the right would be lost.

To cancel, email hello@tapl.coach with a clear statement. A model cancellation form is available on this website. Refunds are made within 14 days of us being told.

Nothing in this policy affects your statutory rights.

Coaching programmes

Coaching is sold as a fixed 12-week programme, not a subscription.

SituationRefund position
Within 14 days, consumer, no sessions deliveredFull refund
Within 14 days, consumer, sessions delivered at your requestRefund less the value of sessions delivered, pro rata
After 14 days, you end the programme earlyNo refund of fees already paid. An early exit fee of 50% of the remaining balance applies.
After 14 days, you paid in full and end earlyRefund of the undelivered portion, less an early exit fee of 50% of that undelivered value
We end the programme because it is not the right fitRefund of any undelivered portion already paid. No exit fee.
Session missed without at least 24 hours noticeTreated as delivered. Not refundable and not replaced.
You complete the programmeNo refund. The service has been delivered.

Worked example. A client on the £2,850 Pro programme paying in three instalments ends the programme after one month. They have paid £950. The remaining balance is £1,900, so the early exit fee is £950. They have paid £1,900 in total for four sessions.

Performance Hub subscriptions

Performance Hub Basic and Performance Hub Plus are rolling monthly subscriptions with no minimum term.

  • You can cancel at any time. Access continues to the end of the period you have paid for.
  • Fees for the current period are not refunded.
  • Annual subscriptions are not refunded part-way through the year. Access continues to the end of the term.
  • Your statutory 14-day right applies to your first subscription payment.

Maintenance

Maintenance is a rolling monthly arrangement with no minimum term.

  • Cancel with 7 days written notice. No exit fee.
  • Fees for the current month are not refunded.
  • Sessions do not accrue or carry forward. A session not taken in a given month is not refundable and does not create an entitlement in a later month.

Alumni Access

Alumni Access is a benefit granted on completing a coaching programme. It carries no fee where Performance Hub Basic is elected, so there is nothing to refund. Where discounted Performance Hub Plus is elected, the subscription rules above apply.

Disputes

If you are unhappy with a charge, contact us at hello@tapl.coach before raising a dispute with your bank or card provider. We aim to resolve billing questions within 5 working days, and we would always rather fix something directly than have it become a chargeback.

If we cannot agree, our complaints procedure is set out separately on this site.

Billing queries

Email hello@tapl.coach. Please include the date and amount of the payment.

Cancellation Policy

This policy covers cancelling individual sessions, ending a programme, and cancelling a subscription. Refund consequences are set out in the Refund and Dispute Policy.

Your statutory right to cancel

If you are a consumer buying at a distance, you have 14 days from entering into the contract to cancel for any reason, whatever else this policy says. See the Refund and Dispute Policy for how that works in practice.

Cancelling or rescheduling a single session

  • At least 24 hours notice, given in writing by email: the session is rescheduled at no charge.
  • Less than 24 hours notice, or not attending without notice: the session is treated as delivered. It is not refunded and not replaced.
  • If we need to cancel or reschedule, which we will avoid wherever possible, we will give as much notice as we can and arrange an alternative time that works for you. You are never charged for a session we move.

Ending a coaching programme

Coaching programmes run for a fixed 12 weeks.

  • You may end a programme early by giving 7 days written notice by email.
  • An early exit fee applies, equal to 50% of the remaining balance of the programme fee. This is the agreed price of ending the programme early, not a penalty for doing so.
  • The programme ends on completion. It does not renew and does not roll over into a subscription.

We may end a programme with immediate effect if a client behaves abusively or threateningly, or if it becomes clear that a client’s needs fall outside the scope of coaching and would be better served by another professional. In the second case we will always try to point you somewhere more useful. No exit fee applies where we end the programme, and any undelivered portion already paid for is refunded.

Cancelling a Performance Hub subscription

  • Cancel at any time. There is no minimum term.
  • Access continues to the end of the period you have paid for.
  • Annual subscriptions run to the end of the term.
  • Cancelling is self-service where the platform supports it, or by email to hello@tapl.coach.

Cancelling Maintenance

  • Cancel with 7 days written notice by email. No exit fee.
  • Performance Hub Plus access, which is included with Maintenance, ends on the same date.

Extended absence

If we are unable to deliver sessions for a continuous period of more than four weeks, you may either extend your programme by the period of absence or end it with no exit fee. The choice is yours.

How to cancel

Email hello@tapl.coach. A model cancellation form is available on this website for consumers exercising the statutory 14-day right, though you are not required to use it.

Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how TAPL collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you visit tapl.coach or get in touch about coaching.

1. Who we are

The ADHD Performance Lab Ltd, trading as TAPL, is the data controller for personal data collected through tapl.coach. We are a company registered in England and Wales under company number 17049785, with our registered office at 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, W1W 5PF.

For anything relating to your privacy or this policy, contact us at hello@tapl.coach.

2. What data we collect

We only collect what we need in order to respond to you and provide coaching.

Information you give us

When you contact us through the form on this site or by email, we collect your name, email address, and the content of your message. You may also choose to share details about your situation, your role, or your availability.

Information collected during coaching

If you go on to work with us, we collect the information necessary to deliver the service, as set out in the Coaching Services Agreement and accompanying Terms and Conditions.

Analytics and cookies

When you first visit the site, we ask whether you are happy for us to use analytics cookies. If you accept, we use analytics tools, which may include third-party providers such as Google Analytics, to understand how the site is used and to help us improve it and develop our services. This may involve collecting limited technical and usage information, such as the pages you view, how you reached the site, and general device or approximate location data. Analytics are only enabled if you accept them, and you can decline or change your choice at any time. We do not use this information to identify you personally.

If you decline, no analytics cookies are set. We do not use advertising cookies, we do not sell your data, and we do not track your activity across other websites.

3. How we use your data

We use your personal data for the following purposes, each with a lawful basis under UK GDPR:

  • To respond to your enquiry and arrange a discovery call, based on your consent and our legitimate interest in responding to people who contact us.
  • To provide the coaching services you have agreed to, based on performance of a contract.
  • To meet legal and professional obligations, such as keeping accounting records and evidencing coaching hours for professional credentialing, based on legal obligation and legitimate interest.
  • To understand how the site is used and improve it, and to inform how we develop our services, where you have accepted analytics cookies, based on your consent.

4. Who we share it with

We never sell your personal data. We share it only with the service providers that help us run the practice, and only as far as needed. These fall into the following categories:

  • form and scheduling tools, which let you contact us and arrange sessions
  • payment processing, we use Stripe to take payment securely, and we never see or store your full card details
  • email, file storage, and video-call providers, used to communicate with you and deliver sessions
  • analytics providers, where you have accepted analytics cookies, which help us understand how the site is used
  • other professional tools that support the running of the coaching practice

All of these providers act as our processors. They are required to protect your data and may only use it on our instructions.

5. International transfers

Some providers may process data outside the UK, including in the United States. Where that happens, the transfer is protected by appropriate safeguards, such as the UK International Data Transfer Agreement or equivalent approved mechanism.

6. How long we keep it

We keep personal data only for as long as we need it. Enquiry messages that do not lead to coaching are deleted within 12 months. Where you go on to work with us, client records are kept for 6 years after the engagement ends, in order to meet UK tax and legal requirements. After these periods, data is securely deleted.

7. Your rights

Under UK GDPR you have the right to:

  • access the personal data we hold about you
  • ask us to correct data that is inaccurate or incomplete
  • ask us to delete your data
  • restrict or object to how we use it
  • request a copy of your data in a portable format
  • withdraw your consent at any time, where we rely on consent

To exercise any of these, email hello@tapl.coach. We will respond within one month.

8. Complaints

If you are unhappy with how we have handled your personal data, please contact us at hello@tapl.coach and we will do our best to put things right.

9. Security

This site is a static website hosted on GitHub Pages. We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data, and we limit access to it to those who genuinely need it.

10. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The current version is always the one published on this page. Last updated: 13 June 2026.
